title: Skill
description: An Agent Skill — SKILL.md content plus optional adjacent files.

name.description: Skill slug (kebab-case). Becomes the directory name in target client output.

description.description: One-line description used by the agent to decide when to invoke the skill.

allowed_tools.description: Tools the skill is permitted to invoke. May be dropped on adapters that lack the field.

files.description: Paths to additional files in the skill directory, relative to the skill root.

license.description: SPDX license expression for the skill content (AgentSkills spec).

compatibility.description: Environment/version constraint the skill requires (AgentSkills spec).

metadata.description: Arbitrary string key/value annotations (AgentSkills spec / Copilot metadata).

paths.description: Activation globs: auto-surface the skill when matching files are in play (Claude paths).

user_invocable.description: Whether the skill is exposed as a user-invocable /command (Copilot user-invocable).

disable_model_invocation.description: Bar the model from auto-invoking the skill (Claude/Copilot disable-model-invocation).
